remarks: Bring Home Happiness in this classic Buffalo Colonial w/ all of the original character & a whole lot of room to grow, set on a tree-lined block in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods. A wide covered front porch w/ tongue & groove ceiling is the perfect spot for morning coffee & meeting the neighbors. This home is ideal for buyers who want space to spread out, character that can't be built new & a yard that makes city living feel like a retreat. Step inside to a sun-drenched living rm w/ a wall of oak-trimmed windows, inlaid border hdwd flrs & the kind of woodwork you simply can't replicate today. Formal dining rm is a showstopper w/ rich oak wainscoting, a built-in window seat, arched niche & French doors that open to a bright bonus rm, ideal as a home office, playroom or sunroom. Updated eat-in kitchen features crisp white cabinetry, subway tile backsplash, quartz-look counters, gas range, stainless appliances & new LVP flooring, w/ a sunny breakfast nook overlooking the yard & plenty of counter space for anyone who knows their way around a stove. Convenient 1st flr powder rm. Upstairs you'll find 4 bdrms, including a primary & 2nd bdrm w/ sweeping bay windows that flood the rooms w/ light & make mornings tough to leave, plus two additional bedrooms with bonus rooms attached that are perfect for a WFH office, nursery or guest space & an updated full bath. Walk-up attic w/ roughly 800 sq ft is ready for your vision, whether a future suite, studio or media rm. Full basement offers laundry w/ washer & dryer, utility sink, sump pump & plenty of room for storage. The backyard is a rare city bonus w/ a deep fenced lawn, oversized concrete patio for entertaining & a 3 car detached garage w/ plenty of off street parking. Whether you're hosting summer cookouts or tailgating on game day, this partially fenced and peaceful outdoor space delivers. Enjoy being just minutes to Delaware Park, the Zoo & all of local restaurants & shopping Hertel Ave has to offer Updates include: Tear off roof, boiler, HWT, electric service all approximately w/i 10 years. All new windows within 5 years as well as exterior paint job. Showings start immediately!
